short: The name@bank address money is sent to on UPI.
seoTitle: UPI ID — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: A UPI ID, also called a virtual payment address or VPA, is the address a UPI payment is sent to — something like business@bank.
definition: A UPI ID, also called a virtual payment address or VPA, is the address a UPI payment is sent to — something like business@bank. It maps to a bank account without exposing the account number or IFSC.
bodyHtml:
Why UPI ID matters

The UPI ID is what a customer's money lands on, so a single wrong character sends the payment to a stranger. It is worth verifying once, carefully, and then never retyping it.

How UPI ID works in practice

Generate your QR code from the stored ID rather than typing it per display, and check the payee name shown in the customer's app before printing a batch of codes.

faq.question: Can one business have several UPI IDs?
faq.answer: Yes, and separate IDs per outlet or counter make reconciliation considerably easier.

faq.question: Is a UPI ID safe to share publicly?
faq.answer: It reveals no account number, so displaying it to receive payments is normal practice.
